answer: The nebula register is checked at draw time, voyage lists the eligible set, and cipher seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 29 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 29 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A farm of 200 pays that 208 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
